candidates.title: Pat Oliphant, Cartoonist Who Skewered the Powerful, Dies at 90
candidates.summary: The winner of countless awards, including a Pulitzer Prize, he was described in 1990 as “the most influential political cartoonist now working.”

candidates.title: Sam Neill’s Best Movie Performances: Where to Stream
candidates.summary: From his global breakthrough in “Jurassic Park” to the more recent “Peaky Blinders,” the actor’s range was always on display.

candidates.title: Tony Rayns, Who Helped Bring Asian Film to the World, Dies at 77
candidates.summary: In reviews and at festivals, he played a key role in introducing English-speaking audiences to directors like Wong Kar-wai, Jia Zhangke and Bong Joon Ho.

candidates.title: Labels for Music Created With A.I. Could Join Explicit Lyrics Warnings
candidates.summary: Major music industry groups, including the organization behind the Grammy Awards, have proposed labels for tracks made with some degree of artificial intelligence.

candidates.title: Paramount-Warner Bros. Merger Is Challenged in Court by California and 11 Other States
candidates.summary: The lawsuit, filed by California and 11 other states, argues that the deal would harm movie theaters and damage America’s entertainment industry.

candidates.title: Shahrnush Parsipur, Iranian Writer Imprisoned for Her Novels, Dies at 80
candidates.summary: Her best-known work, “Women Without Men,” was longlisted for the International Booker Prize this year.

candidates.title: Sizzling, Sexy Age-Gap Romance Novels
